Summary of economic, technical, managerial, and social functions of charging-as-a-service, with references to the bibliography in the original publication, https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S1364032123000369?via%3Dihub#bib1 Economic functions The economic functions that ChaaS can provide to a customer include mitigating economic risks, reducing costs, and generating revenues, as summarized in Table 1. Risk mitigation is a fundamental economic function of the XaaS model because owning an expensive asset, which XaaS enables its customers to avoid, is riskier than paying to access an asset owned by someone else. The risks assumed by the owner of an asset are, broadly, the risk that an asset will unexpectedly lose value (become “stranded”), or, on the other hand, the risk that an asset will incur unexpected costs.
